# Task P0-01: Solution skeleton and build props

**Phase:** 0 · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
Create the .NET 10 solution structure described in `docs/build/REPO_LAYOUT.md` so every later task has a place to put code and a green `dotnet build -warnaserror` / `dotnet test` baseline.

## Deliverables
- `global.json` pinning the .NET 10 SDK (`rollForward: latestFeature`).
- `Directory.Build.props`: `<Nullable>enable</Nullable>`, `<ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>`, `<TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>`, `<AnalysisLevel>latest-recommended</AnalysisLevel>`, `<InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization>`, `<LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>`, deterministic builds, `<Authors>Compilarr contributors</Authors>`, GPL-3.0 licence expression.
- `Directory.Packages.props` with central package management enabled and versions for: `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Sqlite`, `Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Design`, `Serilog.AspNetCore`, `Serilog.Sinks.File`, `Quartz.Extensions.Hosting`, `Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience`, `z440.atl.core`, `YamlDotNet`, `xunit`, `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, `FluentAssertions`, `NSubstitute`, `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Testing`, `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `coverlet.collector` (latest stable versions available on NuGet at the time of the task; record them in the done-report).
- `Compilarr.sln` with projects: `src/Compilarr.Core` (class library), `src/Compilarr.Sources.Slskd`, `src/Compilarr.Sources.YouTube`, `src/Compilarr.Sources.Torznab` (class libraries referencing Core), `src/Compilarr.Api` (ASP.NET Core web project referencing all of the above; minimal `Program.cs` that maps `GET /ping` → 200 empty), `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests`, `tests/Compilarr.Api.Tests` (with one `WebApplicationFactory` test asserting `/ping` returns 200), `tests/Compilarr.Sources.Tests`, and `tests/fixtures/README.md` explaining the fixtures convention.
- Each `src` project has a `ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs` with an empty `AddCompilarr<Name>()` method.
- `.github/` is out of scope (P0-11).

## Allowed paths
- `global.json`, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Compilarr.sln`
- `src/**`, `tests/**`

## Context to read first
- `docs/build/REPO_LAYOUT.md`
- `docs/build/CODING_STANDARDS.md`
- `docs/architecture/STACK.md` §8.3

## Constraints
- No application logic yet; no database; no frontend.
- Package versions must exist on NuGet; do not invent versions. If a package cannot be resolved, leave it out and say so in the done-report.
- Windows and Linux builds must both work (no shell-specific build steps).

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → `Build succeeded.` with 0 warnings.
2. `dotnet test` → all tests pass (at least the `/ping` test).
3. `dotnet list package` shows no floating versions; `Directory.Packages.props` is the single source of versions.
4. Project references: Sources.* → Core; Api → Core + Sources.*; tests reference their subject project.

## Out of scope
- EF Core setup (P0-03), configuration (P0-02), auth (P0-04), frontend (P0-08), Docker (P0-10), CI (P0-11).

## Done-report
Use the format in `docs/build/WORKER_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md`. Include the exact package versions chosen.
